text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: prod-serving-high-latency (INC-2026) — p95 > 5s across eu-west-1. Triggered at 2026-11-03T09:12:56Z. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026
PagerDuty: Notification sent to primary: Mike Oncall (Primary oncall)
Mike Oncall: acking — saw the page on mobile but DND was on, opening phone now. Will check logs.
(PagerDuty): Escalation timer expired for primary (no ACK within 3m) — escalating to secondary: Jill Chen
Jill Chen: acked INC-2026 via web, taking lead. Samir, Priya — I need a quick impact estimate.
Samir Patel: looking at realtime metrics — increased tail latency starting ~09:11Z, error rate still stable. Roughly 6–8% of requests hitting tokenizer/generator path are >5s. Likely batching/queue pressure on model-serving pods.
Jill Chen: thanks. Mike, can you confirm if any recent deploys hit prod around that time?
Mike Oncall: nothing on deploys in last 2 hours from CI. I had a short autoscaler flapping alert earlier but dismissed it as noise.
Samir Patel: grabbing logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-server -c runtime --since=15m | grep "enqueue_time" | tail -n 40`
Samir Patel: pasted snippet:
```
2026-11-03T09:10:43Z model-server-1 enqueue_time=1200ms queue_len=47
2026-11-03T09:11:05Z model-server-3 enqueue_time=980ms queue_len=50
2026-11-03T09:11:30Z model-server-2 enqueue_time=2400ms queue_len=120
```
Jill Chen: queue_len=120 on a few pods — that's the hotspot. Could be autoscaler not reacting fast enough to a short burst.
Priya Reddy: paging in infra — can we spin a temporary pool or scale down some low-priority workloads?
DevOps-Bot: Suggested action: increase replica count for model-serving-deployment from 8 -> 12 (minReadySeconds=20). Command: `kubectl scale deploy/model-serving-deployment --replicas=12 -n inference`
Jill Chen: executing scaling now; will watch tail latency.
Mike Oncall: note — eu-west-1 has a scheduled maintenance window tomorrow but nothing now.
(Jill Chen ran): `kubectl scale deploy/model-serving-deployment --replicas=12 -n inference`
incident-bot: :information_source: Scaling event recorded in incident timeline by Jill Chen.
Samir Patel: after scale, p95 improved from ~5.6s -> ~1.8s within 90s. Still seeing a couple of hot pods with GC spikes. Collecting heap/pid info.
PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026 acknowledged by Jill Chen at 2026-11-03T09:16:22Z
Priya Reddy: thanks team. Any customer-facing impact? We should surface to CS if more than 5% of requests impacted across tenants.
Samir Patel: quick breakdown — majority of affected traffic is internal-heavy tenants and a couple of mid-size customers in EU region, estimated 7% of serving traffic in the time window 09:10–09:18Z. No data-loss, just latency.
Jill Chen: drafting message for CS /status: "We observed elevated generation latency in eu-west-1 causing slow responses for ~7% of requests between 09:10–09:18 UTC; mitigation applied and p95 returned to acceptable levels. No customer data was lost." Thoughts?
Priya Reddy: good. Add that mitigation was autoscale bump and we’re investigating root cause (queueing + GC). Follow-up will include GC traces and autoscaler tuning.
Mike Oncall: FYI I missed the initial ACK because phone DND suppressed push; filing a small blameless note to update mobile push settings for oncall.
Jill Chen: are we comfortable closing? Any need to keep on-call monitoring for X minutes?
Samir Patel: let's keep increased sampling and tracing for 45m to catch regressions. I've set a temporary alert rule to high-sample traces for model-serving pods.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-2026 status changed to mitigated by Jill Chen at 2026-11-03T09:29:30Z — follow-up: postmortem and autoscaler tweak.
PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026 resolved at 2026-11-03T10:03:50Z
Jill Chen: thanks all — I'll own the postmortem and include timeline, root cause hypothesis, and proposed autoscaler/GC fixes. Assigning action items and ETA in the postmortem doc.
Samir Patel: +1 — will attach logs and trace snippets.
Mike Oncall: noted; will update oncall runbook re: mobile DND and PD mobile reminders.
Priya Reddy: nice quick handling — closing thread when postmortem link is posted. :thumbsup:
